title: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Temur: Together Survives the Pack

entities.name: Eshki Dragonclaw
entities.description: The proud wrestler-leader of the Temur, who rose to lead the rebellion and now leads her clan through a blue curse.

entities.name: Alniul, the Twice Whisperer
entities.description: A Temur whisperer and Eshki's old friend who speaks with ancestral spirits and leads the ritual to heal the curse.

entities.name: Ureni
entities.description: The Temur spirit dragon, who sees the threads of the world and watches over the grove, refusing to give direct guidance.

entities.name: Surrak
entities.description: The former huntcaller and last man to lead the Temur, whom Eshki defeated; he lies bound by blue threads in Rainveil Forest.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: The dragonlord who once ruled the Temur and demanded their meat.

entities.name: Rainveil Forest
entities.description: A Temur forest, now silent, where the blue curse flows from a glowing lake at the center.

entities.name: Temur
entities.description: The clan of the mountains, hardy survivors who now suffer a blue-veined sickness.

entities.name: Blue-vein sickness
entities.description: A curse of glowing blue threads that bind people's wrists, throats and tongues, leaving their eyes open as they die within weeks.

entities.name: Whisperers
entities.description: Temur spiritual guides who speak with spirits and were persecuted under the dragons.

events.summary: Ureni sees blue threads binding the sleeping Temur and standing vigil over a camp of the dead.
events.quote: Azure wraps around the people of the Temur as they sleep, leaping from one family to the next, binding wrists and throats and tongues.

events.summary: Eshki wrestles a camp champion at a festival and pins him.
events.quote: Before he knows what's happened to him, she's got him pinned.

events.summary: Alniul arrives with a hunter carrying a stag with glowing blue eyes and asks to speak to Ureni.
events.quote: We need to speak to Ureni.

events.summary: Eshki and Alniul visit Ureni, who tells them it cannot give guidance and that they have two weeks.
Alniul climbs alone beyond a sacred boundary to speak with the spirits and returns weakened, naming Rainveil.
Eshki and Alniul travel toward Rainveil Forest, tending to the dead and quelling those who would abandon the sick.
events.quote: We do not leave our clan behind,

events.summary: They find a whole camp dead around a burned-out fire, and Eshki weeps that night and remembers their names.
events.quote: But, that night, she lets herself weep, and she remembers their names.

events.summary: They enter silent Rainveil Forest and follow blue streams to a glowing lake where Surrak lies wounded.
events.quote: Surrak is paler than Eshki has ever seen him.

events.summary: Surrak, bound to the cursed ground, tells Eshki to leave him and argues that the weak should be left behind.
Alniul stops Eshki and Surrak from fighting with walls of frost and gets Surrak to agree to help.
events.quote: both Eshki and Alniul hear the painful rattle of it.

events.summary: Alniul begins the ritual song with Eshki and Surrak at their sides, summoning snow visions of spirits.
The spirits of those who died in the forest voice their sins of survival, and Alniul asks Eshki whether she welcomes them.
events.quote: do you welcome those who have transgressed in the name of survival?

events.summary: Eshki remembers how she wounded Surrak with ice and recognizes she cast aside the spirits too.
events.quote: When she drove the ice into Surrak's chest, she told herself she'd done it for the sake of progress.

events.summary: Eshki welcomes everyone to the fire and brings Surrak into the song, and a reindeer wanders into the clearing at dawn.
events.quote: And as dawn breaks on Rainveil Forest, a reindeer wanders into the clearing.

events.summary: Months later, Eshki, Alniul and Surrak share a meal and Surrak vows to take back his clan someday.
events.quote: I will take back my clan from you one day.

relations.note: she wounded him and took his title; he vows to challenge her
relations.quote: I have had this wound in my chest here since your friend took my title from me.

relations.note: the Temur spirit dragon who watches over them
relations.quote: The two of you have what you need.

relations.note: now leads the Temur after Surrak
relations.quote: The last man to lead their people.

relations.note: fought to free the Temur from her rule
relations.quote: Atarka and her kin did not easily surrender their rule.
